topics.title: Atlantic City Radio Oddities
topics.summary: Steve the Legend discusses an elusive ‘circle’ while Mrs. Helmsley makes outrageous demands for employment and personal services, including a specific request for a small black child to rub her feet. Jackie Martling shares anecdotes about his family and life experiences alongside humorous observations.

topics.title: Stern & Hahn - Jessica Hahn
topics.summary: Howard Stern’s morning show featured a call-in segment with Jessica Hahn following an argument with co-host Sam regarding compensation for appearing in a commercial and accusations of underpayment, leading to heated exchanges about her earnings and his brother.

topics.title: Letterman Appearance Confusion - Sam Kennison
topics.summary: During a talk show appearance, the host discusses his experience watching Sam Kennison perform on Letterman. The segment is dominated by confusion regarding Kennison’s heavily-bleeped jokes about ‘anal nitrate,’ with significant portions cut from the recording and speculation over whether Kennison intentionally pushed boundaries or struggled with stage fright.” 28 words.

topics.title: Sam’s Recording Concerns
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Sam expresses his desire for solo television performances and resists external influence on his work. The hosts then debate Joe Walsh's vocal similarities to Charlie from Herbs, discussing potential record deals and labels with a focus on New Zealand musician.

topics.title: Stern Discusses Assistants & Radio Decline
topics.summary: During a broadcast segment, Howard Stern discusses his concerns about allowing his assistant Christie to walk downstairs alone and expresses frustration with record companies’ influence compared to MTV. He reminisces about the perceived decline of radio's importance while referencing past experiences and musical preferences.

topics.title: Radio Hosts Discuss Woodstock and Personal Lives
topics.summary: During a radio segment, hosts discuss their past experiences with music, relationships, and the surprising success of a cat-themed shop. They reminisce about Scott Muni’s attractiveness, Howard Stern's recent loss and dating life, and Joe Walsh’s feline business venture while exploring personal reflections on marriage and mortality.
